name: shut
description: SHUT — zero-knowledge password manager (iOS and Android wrappers via Capacitor)

scripts.ios:setup: npm run build:www && npx cap add ios && npm run ios:assets && npm run ios:sync
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/ios-patch.mjs
scripts.android:setup: npm run build:www && npx cap add android && npm run android:assets && npm run android:sync
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android && node scripts/android-patch.mjs
